categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and custom GitHub cache actions to execute cross-built macOS arm64 binaries.
categories.rationale: Adds CI execution for cross-built macOS arm64 binaries on native runners, catching supported-platform defects before release. Without native execution in CI, platform-specific runtime issues like test_bitcoin-qt segfaulting on macOS (#35771) slip through undetected.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and expands test execution machinery to run unit tests on native macOS arm64 runners.
categories.rationale: Closes a major test coverage gap by executing the test suite against release-like cross-compiled binaries on macOS hardware. As noted in the problem statement, this catches realistic platform-specific regressions such as #35771 that cannot be caught on Linux runners.
